prerequisites: at least 7 years of school knowledge in the foreign language

learning_outcomes.text: Students will typically possess foreign language skills comparable to Level C1 according to the CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages).
Students will have sufficiently detailed knowledge of presentation techniques to present on a demanding subject-specific topic* to an international audience.
Students will have knowledge of other cultures and can successfully apply this knowledge in professional communication.
Students will master the confident use of the foreign language and work techniques to comprehend, reflect on, and discuss specialized texts* in a group.
Students will be able to communicate competently and articulately in the foreign language with foreign interlocutors about complex technical relationships*.
Students will possess cultural empathy and can therefore communicate confidently and successfully in an international context/team.

syllabus_topics: Exercises to train communication skills with current texts selected from technical specializations
Intensive training of presentation techniques based on technical topics
Group discussions of current technical topics
Cultural briefings and case studies to heighten awareness of intercultural differences
assessment_rules: The portfolio examination is worth 40 points, consisting of an Oral Examination (M) and a Presentation with accompanying elaboration (R). A maximum of 20 points can be achieved with the Oral Examination, and a maximum of 20 points can be achieved with the Presentation. The oral examination duration is as per the general examination regulations. The presentation is approximately 10-12 minutes, with a written elaboration of approximately 2-3 pages.
